reviews.comment: Do not sign up for her online class for 222. Genuinely the most disorganized class I have ever had here, she is very inconsistent when it comes to posting material and grading exams. Each of the 3 exams I have taken have had ridiculous typos and it's honestly a chance to expect her to fix them. The content isn't even hard which is the funny part.

Great professor. 3 test worth 1/4 of your grade and homework being the remaining 1/4.
Attendance is optional, but just being in present will help you a lot. also cheat sheet allowed
Office hours are great if you have any questions or need help on the exam. She is very willing to help you succeed in the class, but only if you are showing effort.

I LOVED Hande! Her lectures were very enertaining, and easy to follow along. She is very passionate about MSEN and truly wants her students to learn. She does a very good job of setting her students up to succeed in the class and prepares you very well for the exams. Take this class if you can; I could not recommend more!

Modules took forever to be uploaded and tests took forever to grade (first test average was 50). She did make the second test a lot easier and graded it faster. She also let us retake the first test or write an essay for extra credit. Not a great prof online but watch the zoom recordings of the test reviews--very very helpful.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Absolutely do not take her online. Class was disorganized and lacked the proper resources to do well until after the first exam. HOWEVER, she is much better in person, so please take her ONLY in person. I could tell through lecture videos that she is very kind and passionate about material sciences.

reviews.comment: One of the worst and most mismanaged classes I've taken so far. First exam took over 5 weeks to be graded. Nothing about this class is good or useful.

reviews.comment: Dr. Ozcan is the sweetest prof ever. She loves teaching and she loves material. The lectures are pretty easy to follow. The homework is tough but not too long. It does involve a lot of stuff not covered in the lectures, so the textbook is your friend. Exams are hard but she grades nicely. Would recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Her lectures are not the best as they focus on theoretical concepts while hw is mostly actual calculations. Even then hw is not too bad if you read the book. Only assignments are 3 exams and hw but topic list and exam breakdowns are given and you can use a cheat sheet for exams. If you take the time for good hw grades class shouldn't be bad at all.
